newsitem.title: FINLAND: Rautaruukki to set vacuum degassing plant.
newsitem.headline: Rautaruukki to set vacuum degassing plant.

text.p: Finnish steel group Rautaruukki Oy said in a statement on Monday it will invest 135 million markka in a vacuum degassing plant at its Raahe steel mill.
"The project will be completed by the end of 1998 and it is estimated to cost 135 million markka," Rautaruukki said.
Rautaruukki said vacuum degassing reduces the carbon, nitrogen and hydrogen contents of molten steel.

After implementation of the investment, several new products could be added to Raahe Steel's product range and to the product ranges of Rautaruukki's strip products unit and its Metform unit, it said.
Vacuum treated steels are suitable for steel construction, the vehicles industry, the domestic appliance industry, offshore structures and for the construction of large pipes, it said.
